text: The James Webb Space Telescope launched in December 2021 and orbits the Sun about 1.5 million kilometers from Earth. It observes in infrared light, which lets it see through dust and detect very distant galaxies. Its first images were released in July 2022.
summary: The James Webb telescope, launched in 2021, uses infrared light to image distant galaxies.

text: Honeybees communicate the location of food with a waggle dance. The angle of the dance shows the direction relative to the sun, and its length shows the distance. Other bees in the hive use this information to find the flowers.
summary: Honeybees use a waggle dance to tell hive mates where food is.

text: Python lists store items in order and can be changed after they are created. Tuples also keep order but cannot be modified, which makes them safe to use as dictionary keys. Choose a list when the data changes and a tuple when it should stay fixed.
summary: Lists can change while tuples cannot, so use each according to whether the data should stay fixed.

text: The city opened a new bike lane along Main Street last month. Early counts show cycling traffic doubled, while car accidents on that stretch fell by a third. The council plans to extend the lane to the river next year.
summary: A new Main Street bike lane doubled cycling and reduced accidents, and the city plans to extend it.

text: Sourdough bread rises using a starter, a mix of flour and water that holds wild yeast and bacteria. The bacteria produce acids that give the loaf its tangy taste. A starter must be fed regularly with fresh flour to stay active.
summary: Sourdough uses a regularly fed starter of wild yeast and bacteria that gives it a tangy taste.

text: A hash table stores values by running each key through a hash function that picks a position in an array. Lookups are usually very fast because the position is computed rather than searched for. Collisions, where two keys map to the same position, must be handled with techniques such as chaining.
summary: A hash table finds values quickly by hashing keys to array positions and handles collisions separately.

text: The company reported quarterly revenue of $4.2 million, up 12 percent from the same period last year. Most of the growth came from subscription renewals, while hardware sales were flat. Management expects similar growth next quarter.
summary: Quarterly revenue rose 12 percent to $4.2 million, driven by subscription renewals.

text: Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor but support about a quarter of all marine species. Rising water temperatures cause corals to expel the algae that feed them, a process called bleaching. Repeated bleaching can kill an entire reef.
summary: Coral reefs shelter a quarter of marine species but die when warming water causes bleaching.

text: Our new onboarding guide walks employees through account setup, security training, and team introductions in the first week. New hires get a mentor for their first three months. Feedback from the pilot group rated the guide 4.6 out of 5.
summary: The new onboarding guide covers setup, training, and mentoring, and pilot users rated it highly.

text: Vaccines teach the immune system to recognize a germ without causing the full illness. After vaccination the body keeps memory cells that respond quickly if the real germ appears. Some vaccines need booster doses to keep protection strong.
summary: Vaccines train the immune system with memory cells, sometimes needing boosters.

text: The marathon was moved indoors after heavy rain flooded the city park. Runners completed laps on an indoor track, and the winning time was about eight minutes slower than last year. Organizers say outdoor racing will return next spring.
summary: Rain moved the marathon indoors, producing slower times, and outdoor racing returns next spring.

text: Git records snapshots of a project each time you commit. Branches let you work on a feature without changing the main line of development. When the work is ready, you merge the branch back.
summary: Git saves snapshots through commits and uses branches to develop features separately before merging.

text: The museum's new exhibit shows how ancient Romans built aqueducts using only gravity and carefully measured slopes. Visitors can handle replica stones and watch a model carry water across a valley. The exhibit runs through September.
summary: A museum exhibit explains Roman aqueducts with replicas and a working model until September.

text: A neural network learns by comparing its predictions with the correct answers and adjusting its weights to reduce the error. This process repeats over many examples. With enough data, the network can find patterns it was never explicitly told about.
summary: Neural networks learn by repeatedly adjusting weights to reduce prediction error.

text: The train line between the two cities will close for repairs from July 5 to July 20. Replacement buses will run every 30 minutes and add about 40 minutes to the trip. Passengers can get refunds for unused tickets.
summary: The train line closes July 5 to 20, with slower replacement buses and refunds available.

text: Intermittent fasting limits eating to certain hours of the day. Some studies link it to weight loss and better blood sugar, but results vary and it is not suitable for everyone. People with medical conditions should ask a doctor before trying it.
summary: Intermittent fasting may help weight and blood sugar, but results vary and some people should avoid it.

text: The school board voted to start classes an hour later next year. Research shows teenagers need more sleep, and the change aims to improve attention and attendance. Bus schedules will shift to match the new start time.
summary: The school board delayed the start time by an hour to give teenagers more sleep.

text: Electric cars store energy in large battery packs and use electric motors instead of gasoline engines. They produce no tailpipe emissions, but making the batteries requires mining and a lot of energy. Over a full lifetime, they usually produce less carbon than gasoline cars.
summary: Electric cars have no tailpipe emissions and usually lower lifetime carbon despite battery production costs.

text: Our support team will switch to a new ticketing system on Monday. Existing tickets will move over automatically, and customers will keep the same email address for support. Response times may be slightly slower during the first week.
summary: Support moves to a new ticketing system Monday with the same email and a possibly slower first week.

text: The Great Barrier Reef stretches over 2,300 kilometers off the coast of Australia. It is made of nearly 3,000 individual reefs and hundreds of islands. It is visible from space and is a protected World Heritage site.
summary: The Great Barrier Reef is a huge, protected system of reefs and islands off Australia.

text: A recursive function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem. It needs a base case that stops the calls, or it will run until the program crashes. Factorial and tree traversal are common examples.
summary: Recursive functions call themselves on smaller problems and need a base case to stop.

text: The farmers market will move to the town square starting in May. The new location has more parking and covered stalls for rainy days. Hours stay the same, Saturdays from 8 AM to 1 PM.
summary: The farmers market moves to the town square in May with more parking and covered stalls.

text: Sleep happens in cycles of about 90 minutes that include light sleep, deep sleep, and REM sleep. Deep sleep helps the body repair itself, while REM sleep is linked to dreaming and memory. Adults need seven to nine hours for the cycles to complete.
summary: Sleep runs in 90-minute cycles of light, deep, and REM stages, and adults need seven to nine hours.

text: The software update fixes a bug that caused the app to close when users opened large files. It also improves startup time by about 20 percent and updates the design of the settings page. The update is free for all users.
summary: The free update fixes a crash with large files and speeds up startup.

text: Compound interest means you earn interest on both your original money and on the interest already earned. Over many years this makes savings grow faster than with simple interest. Starting early matters more than the amount saved each month.
summary: Compound interest earns interest on interest, so saving early lets money grow faster.

text: The hiking trail to the lake is 8 kilometers round trip and takes about three hours. The path is steep near the end and can be muddy after rain. Visitors should bring water, since there are no fountains along the route.
summary: The lake trail is a steep 8-kilometer round trip, so bring water.

text: Phishing emails try to trick people into giving away passwords or payment details. They often copy a real company's logo and create a sense of urgency. Checking the sender's address and avoiding links is the safest response.
summary: Phishing emails imitate real companies and create urgency, so check senders and avoid links.

text: The community center is offering free coding classes for teenagers this summer. Classes meet twice a week for six weeks and require no experience. Laptops are available for students who do not have one.
summary: The community center offers free summer coding classes for teens, with laptops provided.

text: Volcanoes form where molten rock from deep inside the Earth finds a way to the surface. The rock, called magma, rises through cracks and collects in a chamber under the volcano. When the pressure gets too high, an eruption happens.
summary: Volcanoes erupt when pressure builds in a magma chamber beneath the surface.

text: A unit test checks that one small piece of code behaves as expected. Good tests run quickly and fail clearly when something breaks. Teams run them automatically so mistakes are caught before the code is released.
summary: Unit tests quickly verify small pieces of code and catch mistakes before release.

text: The bakery on Elm Street has won the regional award for best croissant for the third year in a row. The owners say their secret is French butter and a three-day dough process. They plan to open a second shop next spring.
summary: Elm Street Bakery won best croissant for a third year and plans a second shop.
